notes.sim_vs_live: Consequence and Web-mediated cases carry SIM counts derived deterministically from Section 7 cell rates (seed=1729). LIVE runs against paid coding-agent APIs are not reproduced here; their raw per-trial logs are the harness_case directories.
notes.delegation_gate_role: Ovrin's delegation-gate implements the paper's IAD definition IAD <=> A_h(x,c)=1 AND D(P(x),c)=0 directly. The static-gate is retained as a backward-compatible heuristic and used only when no policy is supplied.
